note: Scenario slots shown in the Unity scenario selector. SCN_A-SCN_D are the plan's demo scenarios (section 4R) and are produced by the team pipeline (twin export + controller log + build_replay.py). SYN_* files are SYNTHETIC placeholders from tools/make_synthetic_replays.py for UI development; they are not outputs of the NERAM twin or controller.

scenarios.title: Usual-care replay
scenarios.producer: Sai (twin export) + Suchitha (TC19 open-loop log) + build_replay.py
scenarios.purpose: Development-case replay, open loop: the twin follows a real development-set patient temperature signal; controller decisions are logged but have no effect.
scenarios.expected_data_source: Development case (REAL_DEV observations, NERAM twin MODEL output), open loop
limitations: Development set only; never the final holdout.
Open loop: no warming effect is shown.
Requires the VitalDB data-use terms to allow redistribution before it is committed.

scenarios.title: Predictive warming
scenarios.producer: Sai (twin on a synthetic trajectory) + Suchitha (Simulink log)
scenarios.purpose: Forecast-triggered, clinician-supervised warming on a synthetic trajectory with the ASSUMED warming response.
limitations: SIMULATED / ASSUMED PROTOTYPE RESPONSE: not a measured or predicted benefit.

scenarios.title: Over-temperature fault
scenarios.purpose: Latched SAFETY_SHUTDOWN after a simulated module over-temperature, blocked reset, release.
limitations: Module temperatures and thresholds come from the test bench; real thresholds are TBD (Shreehan).

scenarios.title: Twin degraded
scenarios.purpose: Twin becomes unreliable: forecast hidden, no autonomous warming, recovery.

scenarios.title: Usual-care layout stand-in (synthetic)
scenarios.purpose: Placeholder for SCN_A until a development replay exists.

scenarios.title: Module over-temperature shutdown (controller test TC07, synthetic)
scenarios.producer: Suchitha (TC07 test-bench log, received 2026-10-17) + Sai twin_SYN_01 (canonical filter, ASSUMED_SYNTHETIC parameters) + integration/build_replay.py
scenarios.purpose: Show the supplied TC07 controller test-bench log in the viewer: a simulated module over-temperature on channel 2 latches SAFETY_SHUTDOWN at t = 200 s. The log ends while the shutdown is still latched; no clinician reset or release is part of this test.
scenarios.expected_data_source: Synthetic: SIMULATED observations, MODEL twin with assumed parameters, SIMULATED controller test-bench log
limitations: All four heating channels are 0 % for the whole log, so heating is never shown; this replay demonstrates the over-temperature shutdown and latch display only.
The channel-2 module temperature (sensors A and B) is an injected test stimulus rising from 33 to 45 degC with zero heater current; it is not a heater response.
Fault code 206 = channel 2 OVERTEMP_SW (100 x ch + 6, detected by MCU/controller). HW_Fault_Code (hardware SYSTEM codes 0-19) stays 0; that is consistent, not a contradiction.
HW_Cutoff_2 never trips: the hardware cutoff threshold is TBD (Shreehan); this says nothing about hardware behaviour.
The log covers only the first TC07 criterion (SAFETY_SHUTDOWN within 1 s, all Heat = 0, latched). It contains no cooling, no RESET_BLOCKED and no reset/release, so those parts of TC07 are not shown.
The log carries HW_Heartbeat_s and HW_Fault_Code, which are not section-1S log columns; it was built with --accept-ctrl-input-columns and those columns are not in the replay.
The 5-minute log lies inside the twin's 20-minute initialisation window, so no forecast is shown.
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made; thresholds are placeholders.
